title: Launch decision log & evidence collector
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a working launch decision log + evidence collector for releases that touch RBAC v2, audit logging schema, SIEM exports, or require temporary exceptions. The goal is to provide a compact checklist for release readiness, a reproducible evidence collection procedure (automated + manual), and a lightweight exception approval template when mitigation is required.

Scope and when to use: 
- Use for any release that changes role definitions, service-account behavior, audit schemas, log export pipelines, or SIEM ingestion formats.
- Also used when a release needs a scoped security exception (temporary) due to rollout complexity or external dependency.

Owners & roles (quick):
- Release owner: Product/Eng lead (responsible for collating evidence and tracking open items)
- Security reviewer: Security team reviewer (performs checklist validations, approves/requests mitigation)
- SRE/Infra: Validates SIEM export, log transport resiliency, and retention enforcement
- Compliance/Legal (as needed): For changes that affect retention, PII, or cross-border logging

Checklist (core items — mark Y/N and attach evidence):
1) RBAC v2 changes
   - Are new roles scoped to least privilege? (Y/N) — Evidence: role diff (git/PR link) and matrix mapping to APIs/endpoints
   - Service account creation/rotation accounted for? (Y/N) — Evidence: automation runbook & secret rotation plan
   - Role attachment review completed (users/groups/apps)? (Y/N) — Evidence: exported membership CSV with hashes
   - Migration/compatibility plan for older role bindings? (Y/N/N/A) — Evidence: migration guide/feature-flag plan

2) Audit log schema verification
   - Schema version bump recorded? (Y/N) — Evidence: schema file (json) and changelog
   - Required fields present and typed (timestamp, actor_id, actor_type, resource, action, request_id)? (Y/N) — Evidence: sample logs (ndjson) from staging
   - Before/after state capture for modifying ops included? (Y/N) — Evidence: sample event with before/after payloads (redacted)
   - PII fields assessed and redacted/encrypted as required? (Y/N) — Evidence: redaction map and test output

3) SIEM export & pipeline
   - Export format validated (ndjson with ISO8601 timestamps)? (Y/N) — Evidence: export sample + schema mapping
   - Field mapping to SIEM parsers confirmed (field names, types)? (Y/N) — Evidence: mapping table + parsing unit tests
   - Delivery/transport (kafka/forwarder/s3) tested end-to-end and retried on failure? (Y/N) — Evidence: smoke test logs + replay test
   - Retention & access controls in SIEM reflect policy? (Y/N) — Evidence: SIEM policy screenshot / retention export

4) Evidence automation & integrity
   - Automated collector script run against staging and prod-preview? (Y/N) — Evidence: collector run id + storage location
   - All artifacts stored in evidence bucket with immutable timestamps & checksums? (Y/N) — Evidence: s3://redwood-evidence/launchs/<id>/manifest.json (SHA256 hashes)
   - Access audit (who downloaded/viewed evidence) enabled? (Y/N) — Evidence: access log snippet

5) Release-specific security tests
   - Authn/Authz fuzz tests run (role escalation attempts)? (Y/N) — Evidence: test harness output
   - SIEM ingestion tests: synthetic events show up in detection rules? (Y/N) — Evidence: detection dashboard screenshot

Decision log template (fill per release):
- Release tag / ref: ____________________
- Owner: ____________________
- Date: YYYY-MM-DD
- High-level change summary: (1-2 lines)
- Security impact summary: (bullet)
- Open security items at code freeze: (bullet list with Jira IDs)
- Release decision: APPROVE / APPROVE WITH MITIGATION / DEFER / DENY
- If mitigation required: brief mitigation plan and duration
- Sign-offs (name, role, date): Security:, SRE:, Product:, Compliance(opt):

Sample decision entry (example):
- Release ref: infra-deploy/2024-11-07
- Owner: Devops Eng - Arjun Patel
- Date: 2024-11-07
- Summary: RBAC v2 role rename + audit schema v2 adding model_version field to token events
- Security impact: low risk but requires SIEM parser update and retention update for token events
- Open items: JIRA-SEC-4567 (parser), JIRA-OPS-4321 (retention config)
- Decision: APPROVE WITH MITIGATION
- Mitigation: Delay canary to 10% traffic and run parser migration script during weekend maintenance window; rollback plan documented.
- Sign-offs: Maya Chen (Security, 2024-11-07), Arjun Patel (SRE, 2024-11-07), Lena Park (Product, 2024-11-07)

Exception approval template (for temporary deviations):
- Exception ID: EXC-YYYYMMDD-xx
- Requested by: 
- Scope and reason (short):
- Risk assessment summary (brief):
- Compensating controls (what reduces risk):
- Proposed expiration date/time: 
- Rollback or remediation plan: 
- Approvals required (Security Lead, Head of Product, SRE Director)
- Final decision: APPROVE / DENY (include approver names + timestamps)

Automation: evidence collector (how to run & what it stores)
- Collector name: ri-evidence-collector v0.3 (script + GH action)
- Inputs: release tag, environment (staging/prod-preview/prod), evidence-bucket prefix
- Steps the collector performs (automated):
  1) Pull RBAC role diff from infra repo (git diff) and export to role-diff.json
  2) Query audit service for sample events matching changed APIs (time-bounded) and export ndjson
  3) Validate schema: run schema-validator against exported events and produce schema-validate.log
  4) Run SIEM export smoke test (post event to emitter endpoint) and capture ingestion log
  5) Produce manifest with SHA256 checksums and upload to evidence-bucket under immutable prefix
- Output location format: s3://redwood-evidence/launchs/<release-ref>/<timestamp>/manifest.txt
- Integrity: collector writes manifest and signs it with a CI key. Manual step: security reviewer verifies checksums before sign-off.

Audit log schema (quick reference — minimal set)
- timestamp: ISO8601 string (required)
- level: string (info/warn/error)
- actor_id: string (user/service account id)
- actor_type: string (human/service/automation)
- resource: string (resource path e.g. /models/model-id/deployments/deploy-id)
- action: string (read/write/create/delete/rollout/rollback)
- request_id: string (unique per request)
- trace_id: string (linked traces)
- before: string (redacted json) or null
- after: string (redacted json) or null
- outcome: string (success/fail)
- ip: string (source IP)
- user_agent: string
- deployment_id: string
- model_version: string
- quantization: string (q4/q8/null)
- region: string
- retention_days: integer (applied by pipeline)
- schema_version: string

Note: we encourage sending additional contextual labels to SIEM as "labels": { } but these must be flattened/mapped by the exporter to avoid nested objects in NDJSON ingestion.

SIEM export mapping notes (practical checks)
- Exports must be NDJSON, one JSON object per line. Ensure no embedded newline fields.
- Timestamps must be ISO8601 UTC; include timezone indicator (Z).
- Field names should be short and stable (e.g., actor_id, resource, action). Avoid ephemeral keys.
- If certain fields may contain PII, redact before export and indicate redaction via a redaction_reason field.

Open questions / decisions to record here (working):
- Do we accept nested structured objects in SIEM (labels) or force full flattening at exporter? (Security prefers flattening; infra prefers labels.)
- What is the canonical retention policy per environment for audit logs (30/90/365)? Need final sign-off from Compliance.
- Should model metadata (model_version, quantization) be included on every token-generation event or only on deployment lifecycle events? (Cost vs signal trade-off)

Attachments / evidence pointers (put links here after collector run):
- Role diff: <link to git PR diff>
- Audit sample: <link to ndjson sample>
- Collector manifest: s3://redwood-evidence/launchs/infra-deploy-2024-11-07/manifest.txt
- SIEM mapping doc: <confluence link>

Signing checklist (final sign-off step) — security reviewer should verify:
- All required evidence artifacts present in evidence bucket and checksums match
- SIEM mapping tests passed and detection rules not broken
- RBAC changes are least-privilege and migration/rollback plans exist
- Any temporary exceptions have explicit expiration and compensating controls

Notes to reviewers:
- This is a working doc; expect to paste the final decision block into the JIRA ticket.
- Keep the collector id in the JIRA comment so ops can reproduce the artifact set.

TODOs (next):
- Arjun: add CI job that uploads collector manifest to PR automatically (JIRA-OPS-4729)
- Maya: finalize retention policy recommendation and route to Compliance (due 2024-12-01)
- Lena: update product release checklist to reference this doc (done: partial)

Unresolved: add a concise regression test that ensures model_version presence doesn't bloat token events — proposed: sample 1k events in staging and calculate average payload increase.

Document history: draft started 2024-10-03 by Maya Chen. Iterations: 2024-11-07 (decision example added), 2024-12-05 (automation steps refined), 2025-01-15 (minor wording / added tags).

End of doc.
